summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting an initial notification of PDMR share transactions under Article 19 of the UK Market Abuse Regulation. The filing discloses that the trustee of the company's Buy As You Earn Share Plan purchased 22 ordinary shares on 28 August 2026 at £6.7860 per share on behalf of James Holian, Chief Customer Operations Officer, along with earlier purchases in 2026. These routine employee share plan transactions on the London Stock Exchange represent standard shareholdings notices, not a special situation. No strategic corporate action, tender offer, restructuring, or change in control is involved; the filing is purely administrative disclosure of managerial share acquisitions.
